description: This file defines an Android activity and nested classes demonstrating accessibility support for custom views, including inheritance-based and composition-based approaches to enhance accessibility features for custom UI elements.

classes.name: CustomViewAccessibilityActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating accessibility support in custom views.

classes.name: AccessibleCompoundButtonInheritance
classes.description: Custom toggle button class with accessibility support implemented via inheritance.

classes.name: AccessibleCompoundButtonComposition
classes.description: Custom toggle button class with accessibility support implemented via composition and accessibility delegate.

classes.name: BaseToggleButton
classes.description: Base class for custom toggle button, with check state and text rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: tryInstallAccessibilityDelegate
methods.description: Installs an accessibility delegate for handling accessibility events, only on API 14+.

methods.name: onInitializeAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Enhances accessibility events with the checked state.

methods.name: onInitializeAccessibilityNodeInfo
methods.description: Provides accessibility node info with checkable and checked states and view text.

methods.name: onPopulateAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Adds view text to accessibility events.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view's size based on text layouts.

methods.name: makeLayout
methods.description: Creates a StaticLayout for text rendering.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the toggle text depending on checked state.
